It automates tasks such as medical coding, claim scrubbing, and clinical documentation improvement through modules like RapidCode™, RapidScrub™, and RapidCDI™. The system applies configurable payer rules and AI assistants to structure and validate claims before submission, helping reduce errors and support compliance.
